record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Is every vertex operator algebra V with central charge 24, no nonzero weight-one elements, and the property that every irreducible V-module is equivalent to V while every V-module is completely reducible, necessarily isomorphic to the moonshine module vertex operator algebra?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7.1. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the following three conditions: (1) The central charge of V is 24. (2) V has no nonzero elements of weight 1. (3) Any irreducible V module is equivalent to V as a V-module and every V-module is completely reducible. Then V must be isomorphic to the moonshine module vertex operator algebra.

artifact.status_search_result: This is the well-known FLM uniqueness conjecture for the moonshine module. Among the 71 (conjecturally) holomorphic c=24 VOAs in the Schellekens list, the 70 with nontrivial weight-one space have been classified and shown unique (work of van Ekeren–Möller–Scheithauer, Lam, Höhn, and others). The remaining case—V with trivial weight-one space—is precisely the moonshine module case, and its uniqueness under these hypotheses remains an open problem as of recent literature.

status_evidence.title: My collaboration with Geoffrey — Höhn
status_evidence.snippet: There exist exactly 70 strongly rational holomorphic VOAs with c=24 and non-trivial weight-1 subspace. The remaining case is the moonshine VOA, whose uniqueness is still a big open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The uniqueness of the moonshine module among holomorphic c=24 VOAs with trivial weight-one space is still open.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism Groups and Uniqueness of Holomorphic Vertex Operator Algebras of Central Charge 24
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness results for holomorphic VOAs of central charge 24 with non-trivial weight-one Lie algebra.
status_evidence.claim: The 70 cases with nontrivial weight-one space are settled, leaving the moonshine case.

status_evidence.title: On the Genus of the Moonshine Module
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the moonshine module within the genus of holomorphic c=24 VOAs.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectural uniqueness of the moonshine module remains an active subject.
